verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents Events API v2/REST API/webhooks as documented ingestion sources for monitoring tools (docs-31,46,52,39), plus 750+ integrations (docs-50), and routing/escalation via escalation policies and schedules that connect services to specific responders based on defined rules (docs-7,37,12,13,49). Event Orchestration and alert grouping further support condition-based routing (docs-43,25). Community evidence corroborates escalation behavior working as documented (pagerduty-comm-1), though some friction was reported with API versioning (pagerduty-comm-6) which is a minor caveat rather than a contradiction of the core routing/escalation capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the exact condition-based routing UI/logic beyond docs, and no evidence addressing scale/reliability of routing under complex multi-team conditions.
